page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, relying on external storage attachments, and delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the ecs.r7.8xlarge consistently in the average performance tier across most compute and memory operations. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1865.39 and a multi-core score of 30983.52. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 1689.81 GB/sec, while large block uncached read and write speeds reach 141.73 GB/sec and 65.94 GB/sec, respectively. In database operations, the instance registers a PassMark database score of 13455.54 and handles 30.13 million operations per second in Redis SET tests.

The instance exhibits strong performance in specific workloads, notably achieving 282.15 tokens per second in text generation for a small 135M parameter language model, placing it in the top 25% tier. Hardware-assisted acceleration is supported via Intel AVX-512 and cryptography extensions like AES and SHA_NI. The lack of local storage and GPU hardware makes this instance highly cost-efficient for memory-intensive, non-graphical workloads such as in-memory databases, caching layers, and enterprise applications that require high memory density without the overhead of local NVMe drives.
